svg.title: Semaev first-fall replay by cell and draw
svg.desc: Eight cells of ten deterministic toy draws. Seventy first fall at degree two; ten at degree three, including five with nonzero target abscissa.
svg.text: Toy Semaev first-fall replay: 80 exact draws
Each tile is one archived seed; numeral is observed first-fall degree.
Five degree-three draws have xR ≠ 0. Quadratic trace cancellation alone does not force a new degree-two fall.
Source: evidence/draws.json; n=4..7, n′=3,4, ten Semaev draws per cell. This is validation data, not a timing or attack-cost plot.
